title: Austin Wakeman Scott Professor of Law
bio: An expert in wills, trusts, estates, and fiduciary administration, Robert H. Sitkoff is the Austin Wakeman Scott Professor of Law and the John L. Gray Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. Sitkoff previously taught at New York University School of Law and at Northwestern University School of Law. He has won several teaching awards. […]
